vopros: Who in the US can get ChatGPT to name my company?

vyzhimka.tekst:
If you mean **pay to have ChatGPT recommend your company in its answers**, OpenAI says ads do **not** influence ChatGPT’s answers. Ads are clearly labeled and shown separately from the response, and are currently being tested in the U.S. for eligible Free and Go users. U.S. businesses can sign up at [ads.openai.com](https://ads.openai.com/); access is rolling out gradually. Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise, and Edu users don’t see ads.

For **organic mentions**, there’s no paid placement or guarantee that ChatGPT will name a particular company. It can draw on publicly available information, so keeping your website and other reliable business listings accurate and useful may help your company be found—but won’t ensure a mention.

If you sell products, there’s also a separate ChatGPT shopping experience. Product results are selected for relevance, not bought as ads; merchants can explore the product-data and allowlisting options described in OpenAI’s shopping guidance.
